# ECON 0100 | Vignette E4 | Duopoly

*Vignettes are a certificate of the work done together in Recitation. Due in Recitation.*

Originally, Cauldron Co. makes substantial profits as the only seller of traditional cauldrons. This profit draws in a rival with the same costs: high fixed costs and a constant marginal cost of $MC = 10$. They sell into the same market, so $P = 70 - (q_C + q_R)$, where $q_C$ is The Cauldron Co.’s quantity and $q_R$ is its rival’s. The Cauldron Co.’s marginal revenue is $MR_C = 70 - 2q_C - q_R$. This market is symmetric.

:::: {.columns gutter=1em}

::: {.column width=60%}

### Q1 | Two Cauldron Makers

a\) Find and graph both firms’ best responses. \
b\) Calculate and graph the Nash equilibrium quantities. \
c\) Calculate the Nash equilibrium price in this market.\
d\) Calculate each firm’s profit if $ATC^* = 25$.\
e\) How does this equilibrium compare to the monopoly equilibrium in Vignette E3?
